lead.title: Jeff Dean leaves Google after 27 years to found DiscoLoopAI
lead.summary: Jeff Dean, along with Sanjay Ghemawat, Quoc Le, and Oriol Vinyals, departed Google to launch Discovery Loop (DiscoLoopAI), a startup focused on automating scientific discovery. Backed by Radical Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Alphabet/Google itself.

top_stories.title: Prime Agent — open-source self-improving coding agent released under MIT license
top_stories.summary: Prime Intellect released Prime Agent, a fully open-source MIT-licensed coding agent with persistent autonomous workflows, subagent spawning, and a /refine mechanism. Works with any provider or 100% locally via Ollama.

top_stories.title: Coldtea.ai tops Product Hunt with self-driving software delivery platform
top_stories.summary: Coldtea uses AI agents for QA, production monitoring, bug detection, and automated fixes across the software lifecycle. Topped Product Hunt on August 8 with 459 upvotes.

top_stories.title: Yann LeCun: AGI requires additional conceptual breakthroughs beyond LLM scaling
top_stories.summary: LeCun argued that AGI needs more than pure LLM scaling — world models and new architectures are required. Compared his own 2018 move away from management at Meta to Demis Hassabis's recent role change at DeepMind.

items.title: OpenAI's 'Donut' AI hardware device leaked — wearable form factor revealed
items.summary: A donut-shaped wearable AI device from OpenAI leaked online, pointing to a consumer hardware play that could compete with AI pins and pendants from Humane and others.

items.title: Did Anthropic finally fix MCP? Major update to Model Context Protocol
items.summary: Theo from t3.gg examines whether Anthropic's latest MCP update addresses long-standing issues with tool calling reliability, streaming, and developer experience.

items.title: Google AI leaders exodus — why departures could benefit open model development
items.summary: Key AI leadership departures from Google may accelerate diversity in AI development as talent and research spread across startups and open-weight initiatives.

items.title: Trump's foreign-robot ban sweeps up Canadian firms, blocking US sales
items.summary: The FCC's foreign-robot ban is catching Canadian robotics companies who rely on the US as their primary export market. The rule turns on production location rather than company nationality, sweeping in allied countries.

items.title: Wall Street sees multi-trillion-dollar humanoid robot market opportunity
items.summary: Investment analysts project a multi-trillion-dollar humanoid robot market, pointing to industrial component suppliers rather than robot manufacturers as the key beneficiaries.

items.title: BYD enters humanoid robotics as automakers converge on physical AI
items.summary: Chinese automaker BYD revealed a humanoid robot, joining Tesla and others investing in physical AI for factory automation. Automate 2026 analysis suggests assembly lines are not yet ready for humanoid deployment at scale.

items.title: Soloop — Approval-first Agent OS for solo founders
items.summary: Agentic company-building system with AI CEO, CTO, and CMO agents that solo founders delegate to while retaining approval control. 429 upvotes on Product Hunt.

items.title: BrowserOS neo — Open-source agentic browser for Claude and Codex
items.summary: Privacy-first open-source browser designed for AI agents to run locally using logged-in accounts. 192 upvotes on Product Hunt.

items.title: Rindler — automates web-based manual work
items.summary: Automation platform that handles repetitive web-based tasks teams currently perform by hand. 232 upvotes on Product Hunt.

items.title: Progress AI Observability — agent tracing and evaluation SaaS
items.summary: SaaS platform for tracing, evaluating, and improving AI agents running in production environments. 160 upvotes on Product Hunt.
